answers.evidence:
The implementation was validated with end-to-end tests covering all requirements:

| Test | Result |
|------|--------|
| Empty set → 0.0 | ✓ |
| Single distinct element → ~1.0 | ✓ |
| Duplicates don't change estimate | ✓ |
| Mixed data types (int, float, bytes, None, bool, str, unicode) | ✓ |
| Sparse→dense promotion at custom threshold (100 pairs) | ✓ |
| Merge disjoint sets (1000 + 1000) | 0.58% error |
| Merge overlapping sets (overlap 500 of 1500) | 0.05% error |
| Merge sparse + dense HLLs | 2.20% error |
| Mismatched-precision merge raises ValueError | ✓ |
| Invalid p (3, 20) raises ValueError | ✓ |
| **n = 1** (linear counting path) | 0.00% error |
| **n = 100** | 0.31% error |
| **n = 1,000** | 0.12% error |
| **n = 10,000** | 0.26% error |
| **n = 100,000** | 0.87% error |
| **n = 500,000** | 0.42% error |
| Random trials (10 seeds × 3 magnitudes) | **avg 0.74%, max 1.70%** |

All errors are well within the required **sub-2%** threshold.
